priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Cast Flame Shock if the damage-over-time effect is not ticking on the target.
Cast Primordial Storm if you have 9+ Maelstrom Weapon stacks, or 5+ stacks if the Primordial Storm buff is about to expire.
Cast Sundering if Surging Elements or Feral Spirit is talented.
Use offensive trinkets and potions during your Ascendance or Doom Winds windows.
Cast Windstrike (replaces Stormstrike during Ascendance) as long as you have at least 1 Maelstrom Weapon stack.
Cast Tempest (replaces Lightning Bolt) when you reach 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Lightning Bolt when you reach 10 Maelstrom Weapon stacks to avoid overcapping.
Cast Stormstrike if you have 1.8 or more charges available or while Doom Winds is active.
Cast Lava Lash if it is available.
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever the proc is available.
Cast Lightning Bolt as a priority filler if you have 8 or more Maelstrom Weapon stacks.
Cast Crash Lightning if the buff is missing or as a final filler, followed by Lightning Bolt at 5+ stacks.
